author: Camemes
body:
Hello, today I am reporting a guy who tried to team kill me, In this video you can clearly see his intensions to burn me with firecharges. It didn't work because they are disabled but he wanted to and tried to.
Video Link: http://youtu.be/b_MNyVXk4Zs
I believe he deserves a reasonable punishment!
